title: The local logarithmic Brunn-Minkowski inequality for bodies of revolution
summary: We prove the local logarithmic Brunn-Minkowski inequality for bodies of revolution. Furthermore, we give a generalization for one origin symmetric body of revolution and one body of revolution that does not need to be symmetric and restrict possible equality cases. The proof uses an operator theoretic approach together with the decomposition of spherical functions into isotypical components with respect to rotations around a fixed axis.
